Class RedisCache

java.lang.Object
org.swarmforge.server.persistence.RedisCache
public class RedisCache extends Object
Redis cache for real-time simulation state. Uses Lettuce client for async/reactive access. Cache keys: - sim:{worldId}:state - Current simulation state - sim:{worldId}:tick - Current tick number - sim:{worldId}:individuals - Individual positions (hash) - sim:{worldId}:pheromones:{z} - Pheromone layer (hash by morton key)
